data.domains_json_windows: the first 4 windows of the unshuffled test loader, length 100, as scripts/08_domains.py takes them

checkpoints.note: Both checkpoints are the weights at training step 250 of 3000, where validation rank IC peaked, from the same seed. Outside the timescale parameters (`dt_proj` and the timescale rows of `x_proj`) their weights differ by at most 2.1 percent of each tensor's largest entry (`layers.0.x_proj.weight`). The attacked sensitivities of the two arms are therefore close, and the arms differ mainly in the bounds, where the timescale parametrisation enters.

perturbation.block: any point within delta in sup-norm of the block's realised normalised input
perturbation.model: any point within eps in sup-norm of the model input

attack.block: per window: rank targets by random sign probes at the smallest delta; exact gradient rows of the best-ranked targets; per delta, sign-gradient ascent on the largest change over all positions from the two best rows' signs and from a random corner, and on the largest change at the last position from its best row; step size from 2 delta down to delta / 8; every best point rescored with incremental.contribution in float64
attack.model: per window and eps: sign-gradient ascent on +f and on -f from the input gradient's sign; step size from 2 eps down to eps / 8; best points rescored with the float64 reference forward pass; width = max - min including the nominal prediction
